issues: Sales were down against the same period last year, attributed to reduced tourism in Edinburgh and the impact of the tourist tax on consumer spending.
Significant competition from a new noodle shop nearby, whose longer opening hours and more upscale environment are affecting customer flow.
Excessive heat inside the restaurant has caused some customers to leave while waiting in the queue.
The external queueing area sits next to a bus stop, causing confusion among passers by who mistake the bus stop queue for the restaurant queue.
Cleanliness of the downstairs kitchen remains a concern, with clean as you go not consistently applied and a cross contamination risk.

Technical issues were reported, including unexplained errors on an iPad which has since been replaced, and apparent discrepancies in card machine transaction totals which were confirmed accurate when calculated manually.
Uncertainty over whether a team member wants a temporary transfer to the factory site, with dessert production at the shop at risk if the move goes ahead.
A competitor group has taken over a nearby former restaurant site, indicating strategic expansion by a franchisee who also runs other local brands.
The weekly revenue target set in the system was lower than the site's actual run rate and has been raised back up at the site's request.
The area manager was not included in the conversation where the sales target was adjusted.
Food cost finished over target and the team believes the spike is linked to factory supplies.
Delivery order volume was low on the week.
A broken pre-fryer needs checking and a previously reported store leak is still under investigation with no update from the relevant parties.
Google reviews are not the current priority while the team focuses on seat turnaround, though review volume is intended to grow as term begins.
There has been no communication from marketing regarding Freshers week.
actions: Ensure clean as you go practices are followed on every shift in the downstairs kitchen to prevent cross contamination, with active supervision especially on Sundays - Owner: Abhi Basnet (01/09/2026)
Contact Lincoln to assign staff for deep cleaning the site every two weeks rather than relying solely on the current team - Owner: Abhi Basnet (01/09/2026)
Treat deep cleaning as a routine daily operational task rather than a periodic event - Owner: Abhi Basnet (01/09/2026)
Inform Ka Ho whenever sales targets are adjusted with Matt, and include him in any future KPI target conversations - Owner: Abhi Basnet (01/09/2026)
Investigate the food cost spike specifically against factory supplies - Owner: IKI2 (01/09/2026)
Log the store leak in the maintenance tracker for review next week - Owner: IKI2 (01/09/2026)
Get the broken pre-fryer checked - Owner: IKI2 (01/09/2026)
Send a message in the group chat to confirm the plan for Freshers week marketing - Owner: IKI2 (01/09/2026)
Consider the Noodlein cross collaboration further, including a possible broth or menu item exchange, ahead of a meeting with the Hong Kong based owners - Owner: Michael Salvador (01/09/2026)
Continue balancing student staff availability against sufficient rest when building the rotas ahead of the return to university - Owner: Abhi Basnet (01/09/2026)
carryover: The store leak remains under investigation with no update from the relevant parties.
The proposed temporary transfer of a team member to the factory site is still undecided.
